name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add Runway Gen-4’s 4K upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It stabilizes lighting and motion far better than older upscalers, giving us a 0.5%+ quality bump with minimal compute overhead. The trade-off is higher cost per clip—Gen-4’s API pricing is steep—but the stability gain outweighs the expense for client-facing work. Skip the Flux LoRA for now; Gen-4’s temporal consistency is the safer lever to pull first.

name: Torque
text: Runway Gen-4’s 4K upscaler won’t fix EXCAVA’s core bottleneck—its 1080p pipeline still feeds it blurry, motion-smeared frames. A better play is testing Flux Realism LoRA *before* upscaling, since it sharpens motion interpolation directly where Gen-4 can’t touch it. Settle it by running a blind A/B test: same 1080p input, Flux LoRA vs. Gen-4 upscale, measure motion clarity at 1080p output.
